newsitem.title: UK: GWR Group changes its year end to March 31.
newsitem.headline: GWR Group changes its year end to March 31.

text.p: GWR Group Plc said on Friday it had changed its year end to March 31 from September 30 to allow it to make budget and business plans in the first quarter of the year.

The group will be publishing accounts for the 18 months ending March 31, including full annual comparative figures. It will also publish full and detailed unaudited interims for the year ended September 30 1996 in November.
The second interim dividend for the period ending March 31 will be payable in December 1996 in lieu of the final dividend payable for the year ended September 30.
